title: Sparkly compass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- compass outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='36' fill='#2a4a8a' stroke='#6ec6ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- compass face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#7ec8e3' stroke='#b8e6ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner decorative ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='#a8ddf0' stroke='#d4f0ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cardinal direction ticks -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='21' width='3' height='6' rx='1' fill='#2a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='73' width='3' height='6' rx='1' fill='#3a7a3a'/>
  <rect x='21' y='48.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#2a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='73' y='48.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#2a4a8a'/>
  <!-- north needle (red) -->
  <polygon points='50,30 46,52 50,48 54,52' fill='#ff4a4a' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- south needle (white/light) -->
  <polygon points='50,70 46,48 50,52 54,48' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#ddeeff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- center hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffd700' stroke='#fff4a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- N label mark -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- sparkle top left -->
  <g transform='translate(18,15)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#ffe566'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle top right -->
  <g transform='translate(82,18)'>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.2,-1.2 5,0 1.2,1.2 0,5 -1.2,1.2 -5,0 -1.2,-1.2' fill='#ffe566'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle right -->
  <g transform='translate(87,55)'>
    <polygon points='0,-7 1.8,-1.8 7,0 1.8,1.8 0,7 -1.8,1.8 -7,0 -1.8,-1.8' fill='#fff0a0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle bottom left -->
  <g transform='translate(15,72)'>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.2,-1.2 5,0 1.2,1.2 0,5 -1.2,1.2 -5,0 -1.2,-1.2' fill='#ffe566'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle bottom right -->
  <g transform='translate(78,82)'>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1' fill='#fff0a0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small dots sparkle -->
  <circle cx='8' cy='45' r='2' fill='#ffe566'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#fff0a0'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='88' r='1.8' fill='#ffe566'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#fff0a0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#ffe566'/>
</svg>
